name: Visa
notes: Market cap $676.68B at $368.64/share, read 2026-09-08. SOURCES DISAGREE: companiesmarketcap.com gave $688.26B and cited Nasdaq at $659.09B on the same day — a ~4% spread that is the share-class question. Visa's FY2026 Q3 10-Q cover page (shares as of 2026-07-21) lists Class A 1,704,112,694 + B-1 2,180,148 + B-2 486,669 + B-3 60,589,871 + C 17,059,152 = 1,784,428,334 shares; at $368.64 that face count gives $658B, close to the Nasdaq figure. The $676.68B figure used here is higher because B and C shares convert to Class A at multiples above 1:1, so an as-converted count exceeds the face count. Either way the figure is intended to cover ALL share classes, not Class A alone. Headcount from the FY2025 10-K: "we grew our total workforce from approximately 31,600 in fiscal 2024 to approximately 34,100 employees in fiscal 2025" (fiscal year ended 2025-09-30).
source: stockanalysis.com/stocks/v (market cap); Visa FY2025 Form 10-K, Human Capital (headcount); Visa FY2026 Q3 Form 10-Q cover page (share counts)
